title: Reject unauthenticated generation-ahead key and DAO slots
description: SECURITY review: FileKeyStore._best_slot_locked and TwoSlotFilePersistence._validate_anchored_slot automatically advance the trusted external anchor when the selected attacker-writable slot is exactly anchor+1. Slot checksums are unkeyed, so an offline/local storage attacker can forge a valid generation-ahead seed or arbitrary DAO TX/RX floor and have load authenticate it into the independent anchor. Two-slot storage retains the anchor-matching committed slot; loads must select the slot exactly matching the external anchor and ignore/reject unanchored newer slots rather than advancing trust from file contents. Add forged +1 restart tests for key, DAO TX, and DAO RX.
